draft.email:
Dear Orion Sensor Systems, LLC,

We have reviewed invoice OSS-71840 dated 2026-10-01 and identified a discrepancy regarding freight charges. The freight amount of $295.00 exceeds our allowance of $123.00 (the larger of 5% of goods or $100.00) and is not itemized on purchase order PO-2026-1107. As discussed, we will pay for the goods totaling $2460.00 while requesting that the freight charge be removed or justified. Please let us know how you would like to proceed with this adjustment.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Ridgeline Fabrication Accounts Payable
